title: On-site water consumed by US data centers, modeled, 2014–2028
description: Bar chart of Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory's modeled estimate of the water consumed on site by all US data centers, in billions of liters a year: 21.2 in 2014, about 29 in 2018, 66 in 2023, and a projection for 2028 of about 146 at the low end and about 275 at the high end. The 2018 and 2028 values are read from the report's figure 5.9. Data: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report, figure 5.9.
heading: ON-SITE WATER CONSUMED · BILLION LITERS A YEAR · MODELED
